newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Payout to TVK expected in July.
newsitem.headline: Payout to TVK expected in July.

text.p: The earnings of Hungarian chemicals firm TVK should be boosted by a payout from the state privatisation agency APV in July, a TVK official said.

"I am not sure that we will receive the money by June 30, but we will certainly get it in the first days of July," TVK financial director Margit Tallai told Reuters, adding that the payout would boost TVK's pre-tax profits.
APV announced on Wednesday that it would pay 5.281 billion forints ($28.4 million) to TVK, without disclosing when it would transfer the money.
If the amount is transferred only after June 30, its impact will not appear in TVK's earnings report for the first half of the year, only in third quarter company figures.
TVK closed at 3,310 forints on the BSE on Wednesday.
